modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mtrlte: A Minecraft Transit Railway expansion: dynamic head and tail lights with visible beams, rain mist and spray, train collisions that knock you flying, signal / projector / PIDS linkers, a 3D beam editor and Xiamen-style platform screen door blocks.
main.hint: Everything lives under a section; only Done here writes the file
cat.hint.global: Pick a section - the sliders live one level down
cat.hint.siding: %s  ·  only parameters this siding can override
options.particles.mtrlte.spray.tooltip: LTE's rain-spray streaks (mtrlte:spray). Sodium Extra lists it automatically from the particle registry; turning it off here only hides the spray, not splash, the light band or the cone.
death.attack.mtrlte.trainLow: %1$s was fined 5000 HKD and died of sheer anger
death.attack.mtrlte.trainHigh: %1$s vanished into the scream of the passing train
reset.confirm.title: Reset to defaults?
reset.confirm.global: Every global value goes back to its default, and all per-siding overrides are cleared (sidings follow the globals again). Nothing is written to disk until you press Done; Cancel undoes it.
reset.confirm.siding: Every override for this siding is deleted, so all of its parameters follow the globals again (this is not "copy the global defaults in"). Nothing is written until Save & back; Back undoes it.
beam.hint.vehicles: Only vehicles seen in this world · pick one to edit its beams
beam.noVehicles: No vehicles in this world yet
beam.noVehiclesHint: Ride an MTR train once, then open this again
beam.hint.list: Tick to multi-select · click a row to edit · edits apply live, export writes the file
beam.keepOne: Keep at least one beam (an empty list means "no override")
beam.discard.title: Discard edits?
beam.discard.confirm: The runtime overrides written for %s vehicle(s) in this session are dropped; those vehicles go back to the resource pack / automatic detection. Files already exported are not affected.
beam.type.head: head
beam.hint.vector: pos / rot are whole vectors: ↺ on one axis restores all three to the detected value

color.hint: Click a swatch, or type a hex value
hint.damageInCreative: Creative players can also be hurt or killed by trains (spectators remain immune)
hint.json: Other values (tail light, relight tuning, beam brightness) are in config/mtrlte.json
hint.author: by 厦航在拍车的无名机长 (kigurumiLTY)

beam3d.title: Beam editor · 3D
beam3d.dragMove: Moving beam %s: drag to change its position

beam3d.axisHint: Drag a coloured axis: X red / Y green / Z blue — only that axis moves (Shift = 0.5)

beam3d.snap.title: Snap (nose = -Z)

beam3d.noModel: No previewable model for this train
beam3d.noModelHint: Only JonModelTrainRenderer trains carry a model; it may also not be loaded yet
beam3d.noVehicles: No vehicles available (resource pack not loaded?)

beam3d.prunedHint: disableBuiltInTrains=true: MTR's built-in types were pruned out of the registry (that is why the list is empty)
beam3d.import.title: Import resource pack
beam3d.import.hint: Pick an MTR pack the game has NOT loaded (zip or folder); its mtr_custom_resources.json and models are read on the fly

beam3d.import.pathEmpty: Enter a resource pack path (zip or folder) first

message.mtrlte.signal_link.lamp_set: Signal light %s selected - right-click a track node or another light
message.mtrlte.signal_link.no_rail: That node has no track connected

tooltip.mtrlte.projector.hint: Right-click a projector then any block inside a station, a platform block or a track node (either order - works outside the station area too)
tooltip.mtrlte.projector.selected_platfo: Platform selected (outside any station, station not resolvable): %s
tooltip.mtrlte.projector.unbind: Sneak + right-click the projector to unlink

message.mtrlte.projector.station_set: Station "%s" selected - right-click a projector to finish

message.mtrlte.projector.wrong_dim: That target is in another dimension - pick it again
message.mtrlte.projector.projector_gone: That projector is gone - pick another one

message.mtrlte.projector.station_mismatc: Note: MTR's own renderer resolves the station from the projector's position, and this projector is not inside "%s" - the link is saved, but it will not show arrivals outside the station area
tooltip.mtrlte.pids.hint: Right-click a PIDS then a platform block or a node on the same track (either order - works outside the station area too)
tooltip.mtrlte.pids.unbind: Sneak + right-click the PIDS to unlink
message.mtrlte.pids.pids_set: PIDS %s selected - right-click a platform block or a track node
message.mtrlte.pids.node_set: Node %s selected - right-click a PIDS to finish
message.mtrlte.pids.no_platform: No platform nearby, and the rail walk along this track did not reach one - right-click a platform block or a node on the platform
message.mtrlte.pids.wrong_dim: That target is in another dimension - pick it again
message.mtrlte.pids.pids_gone: That PIDS is gone - pick another one
message.mtrlte.pids.outside_station: Note: MTR's own renderer resolves the station from the PIDS position, and this PIDS is not inside any station - the link is saved, but it will not show arrivals outside the station area
message.mtrlte.pids.platform_mismatch: Note: this PIDS belongs to station "%2$s" but the platform written ("%1$s") is not part of it - MTR only shows platforms of the station at the PIDS position, so the screen will be empty
message.mtrlte.pids.verify_failed: The write did not stick (read back platforms=[%s], block entity %s) - please send this line to the author
message.mtrlte.pids.not_linkable: Nothing linkable here - right-click a platform block / track node, or the PIDS itself
